title: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion
author: Robert B. Cialdini
summary: Cialdini sets out the principles that drive people to say yes, such as reciprocity, social proof and authority, using experiments and his own undercover research.
readIf: you want to understand and resist the tactics of salespeople and marketers.
skipIf: you want a recent, updated study set or a manual for manipulation.
